Splice a joined gene's segments into one CDS

Source: R/annotate_utils.R
splice_join_cds.Rd

Concatenates a join group's segment (exon) sequences in 5'->3' order and translates them, matching the export-time splice logic so the manual editor and the exported feature table agree. Used both by [export()] and by the annotate-details editor's spliced-CDS preview / alignment.

Usage

splice_join_cds(members, seq, genetic_code)

Arguments

members

data frame of the group's annotation rows. Requires columns pos1, pos2, direction, start_codon, stop_codon, partial_start, partial_stop.

seq

the scaffold assembly sequence (DNAString/DNAStringSet) the members belong to.

genetic_code

a resolved Biostrings genetic-code vector (e.g. `session$userData$gcode` or `Biostrings::getGeneticCode("2")`).

Value

list with `dna`, `translation` (terminal stop stripped), `start_codon`, `stop_codon`, `partial_start`, `partial_stop`, `pos1`, `pos2`, `length`, `direction`, and `segments`: a data frame (one row per exon, ordered 5'->3') with `member_row` (index into `members`), `pos1`, `pos2`, `aa_start`, `aa_end`.
